cards.title: Breathless Stare
cards.text: Sit knee-to-knee and hold eye contact for 30 seconds while your partner whispers three things they crave about you.

cards.title: Candlelight Massage
cards.text: Warm your hands and give your partner a slow 45-second neck and shoulder massage—end with a kiss behind their ear.

cards.title: No-Hands Tease
cards.text: If you both want, share 30 seconds of slow kisses along the jaw and neck. Keep hands free; either of you can stop or pass.

cards.title: Earlobe & Collarbone
cards.text: Lightly soft kiss your partner's earlobe, then trail slow soft kiss and warm breaths down to their collarbone for 30 seconds.

cards.title: Velvet Control
cards.text: Gently pin your partner's wrists above their head with one hand for 45 seconds—kiss anywhere except their lips while they stay still.

cards.title: Slow Unwrap
cards.text: Choose one layer or accessory on your partner and remove it as slowly as possible using only one hand and steady eye contact.

cards.title: Kitchen Counter Spark
cards.text: Move to the kitchen right now: lift or lean your partner against the counter for a slow, movie-style kiss.

cards.title: Living Room Floor Picnic
cards.text: Dim the lamps, grab two drinks, and sit shoulder-to-shoulder on the rug—no phones for the next 15 minutes.

cards.title: Against the Wall
cards.text: Back your partner gently against the nearest doorway or wall and hold a teasing 30-second embrace.

cards.title: Mirror Reflection
cards.text: Stand behind your partner in front of a mirror for 45 seconds—wrap your arms around their waist and kiss their neck while watching each other.

cards.title: Steamy Shower Pact
cards.text: Scratch-off promise: your next shower together happens in dim light with zero rushing and a full-body lather.

cards.title: Stolen Elevator Moment
cards.text: On your very next date out, claim a bold 5-second kiss in an empty hallway, parking deck, or elevator before the doors open.

cards.title: Midnight Confession
cards.text: Reveal one romantic scene from a movie or dream that you've secretly wanted to recreate with your partner.

cards.title: Hotel Strangers
cards.text: Spend the next 5 minutes pretending you just met at a midnight lounge—win your partner's room key with pure charm.

cards.title: Blindfolded Taste & Touch
cards.text: Partner wears a blindfold for 60 seconds: surprise them with a warm kiss, an ice cube or cold glass, and feather-light fingertips.

cards.title: Cocktail Trail
cards.text: Place a single drop of wine, cocktail, or honey on your partner's neck or collarbone—and slowly warming it clean.

cards.title: 60-Second Boss
cards.text: For one full minute, one partner becomes 'Tonight's Director' and whispers slow, bold instructions while the other obeys.

cards.title: Velvet Coupon
cards.text: Winner keeps this golden scratch card: redeemable tonight for one bold fantasy or playful caress-and-kiss forfeit.

cards.title: Lip-Hover Stare
cards.text: Hover 1 cm from your partner's lips for 35 seconds, brushing breath without kissing until the final second.

cards.title: Ear-to-Throat Trail
cards.text: Softly soft kiss their earlobe, then soft kiss and kiss slowly down the side of their throat for 35 seconds.

cards.text: Warm both palms and slide them under your partner's shirt to explore their spine, ribs, and waist (40s).

cards.title: Collarbone Mark

cards.title: Pinned Behind Back
cards.text: Hold both of their wrists in view with one hand while kiss and kissing their neck and chest (45s).

cards.title: Inner-Thigh Tease

cards.title: Lips-Only loosen

cards.title: Unspoken Craving

cards.title: Blindfold soft kiss Test
